feature: Set kode Standard Code untuk PLUS suspension yang dimuat sekali saat start (PROCESSING_STAGE, PS_REASONS_ALLOW_TS, CPC_CFC_ELIGIBLE_CODES)
note: SuspensionProcessingHelper di ocmsadminprivateapi (@PostConstruct) membaca tiga kategori ocms_standard_code sekali saat service start untuk memvalidasi suspension dari PLUS (stage yang boleh, PS yang mengizinkan TS, kode yang boleh di CPC/CFC). Perubahan kategori itu lewat halaman Standard Code baru terbaca setelah restart. Mungkin milik story suspension PLUS di epic lain; tidak ada di 5 story chunk ini kecuali sebagai catatan di OCMS39.12.
note_en: SuspensionProcessingHelper in ocmsadminprivateapi (@PostConstruct) reads three ocms_standard_code categories once at service start to validate suspensions from PLUS (allowed stages, PS reasons that allow TS, codes allowed at CPC/CFC). A change to those categories on the Standard Code page is only read after a restart. It may belong to a PLUS suspension story in another epic; it is not in the 5 stories of this chunk except as a note in OCMS39.12.

feature: Guard pembayaran sedang diproses di eService (blok bayar ulang dalam 300 detik, pesan E10/E11)
note: Portal publik memblok notice yang transaksi pembayarannya masih diproses (selisih waktu <= 300 detik, konstanta di code) dengan pesan E10, dan setelah itu memakai logic E11/flag eVON. Bukan konfigurasi stage atau grace period, jadi tidak dihitung di OCMS39.15. Kemungkinan milik story payment eService di epic lain.
note_en: The public portal blocks notices whose payment transaction is still being processed (time difference <= 300 seconds, a constant in the code) with message E10, and afterwards uses the E11/eVON flag logic. It is not stage or grace-period configuration, so it is not counted in OCMS39.15. It probably belongs to an eService payment story in another epic.
